source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
In Resolve Pre-battle Abilities, a unit whose models all have **Scouts X"** may do 1 of these:

1. If it is in **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**, set it up anywhere wholly within your own deployment zone.
2. If it is wholly within your own deployment zone, it may make a **[Scout move](vsdata:core-rule/scout-move)** under 24.32.
3. If it is aboard a **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** wholly within your own deployment zone and every model aboard has Scouts, that **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** makes a **[Scout move](vsdata:core-rule/scout-move)**.

options.where: anywhere wholly within own deployment zone

options.state: embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT wholly within own deployment zone
options.requires: every model embarked in that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has Scouts
